subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Dove and Peace
description: One-minute skill: The Dove and Peace.

hook.text: Noah's dove returned with an olive branch. The flood was over. Peace, hope, and renewal—one small bird.

buildup.text: Doves were sacred to Aphrodite and Ishtar before the Bible. The love goddess claimed the gentle bird first.

discovery.text: At Jesus's baptism, the Holy Spirit descended as a dove. Christianity made the bird divine—not just peaceful.

twist.text: Picasso drew a dove for a 1949 peace poster. A biblical bird became a political symbol during the Cold War.

climax.text: The dove travels from goddess of love to Holy Spirit to peace movement. One bird, three eras, same gentleness.

punchline.text: White wings. Ancient peace. Still flying.

quiz.question: Which artist drew the famous dove for a 1949 peace poster?
